column3: Open /fleet.html?w=1440#theme=t3-light. Click Agents, expand and collapse a host and harness, select an agent, click Open chat and Nudge or Answer and verify feedback. Click Needs you and verify filtering and the online count against visible hosts. Scroll to Machines and k3s using their tabs, inspect a pod and its actions, then scroll through the portfolio and factory cards to the bottom. Capture each issue and do not finish on the first screen.

Open /fleet.html?w=1440. Scroll to the portfolio card, switch portfolios, expand every product and feature, open a task and use Set next. Verify horizon, shared ownership and task states. Scroll to hosts and factory and interact with a control in each. Visit / and click through its sections to the footer. A screenshot-only inspection does not complete this goal.

Open /fleet.html?w=1440. Scroll to the factory card, switch Spine and Radial, click live, blocked and failing nodes, inspect reasons, use Queue fix and Open node, compare all stats to the visible graph and verify feedback. Scroll through hosts and portfolio and click their controls, then visit / and scroll through every section.

Open / and find the theme controls. Click each light and dark host preset and inspect text, focus rings and surfaces. Scroll through every gallery section and click representative cards and actions. Open /fleet.html?w=1440#theme=t3-light and then #theme=t3-dark, clicking tabs and actions across all three cards in each theme. Report dark surfaces in light themes and unreadable labels with captures.

At a 390px viewport open /fleet.html?w=390#theme=t3-light. Tap Hosts tabs and Needs you, expand a host and agent, tap an action and check the title and online count. Scroll through portfolio and factory, tap all tabs, expand tasks and focus graph nodes, try both layouts and look for clipped text or horizontal overflow. Open / and tap navigation and theme controls, scrolling to the bottom.

In the Tern web client create a synthetic chat if needed, submit /hosts, expand each host and harness, switch Agents, Machines and k3s, select agents and pods, click the enabled Open chat, Nudge and pod actions. Verify disabled controls explain why. Scroll the transcript and open /fleet, interacting with every fleet section. Do not call missing backend data a PASS.

In Tern submit /portfolio, expand every visible product and feature, open a task and Set next, switch portfolios and inspect shared ownership. Scroll old and new transcript messages and submit /hosts, testing a tab and an agent action there. Record missing data and unavailable states explicitly.

In Tern submit /factory, switch graph layouts, focus nodes of every visible state, inspect reasons, click Queue fix and Open node when enabled, compare stats and feedback. Scroll the transcript, submit /fleet and interact with each card. Never infer success just because a button exists.

In a new synthetic Tern chat submit /glide. Click through Detect, Build memory, Turn on, Skill router, Hill climb and Offload approvals, checking approval, refusal and unavailable feedback without downloading models. Scroll through every proof card and return to earlier actions. Use only the isolated synthetic profile.

Submit /glide focus, click Start block and its approval then End block and inspect the digest. Submit /glide taste and /glide recall frontend, inspect empty and unavailable states, return through transcript history and click every visible card action. Scroll all sections, recording unsupported integrations rather than inventing a PASS.

Open live voice with its visible control or /live, inspect idle, listening, thinking and speaking orb states where available. Click the helper lanes and Stop, open their states and close them. Scroll the transcript, inspect permissions and provider errors, then reopen the panel and resize. Record microphone or provider gaps as unverified, not app defects or PASS.

Send one synthetic one-line request to the configured free model, wait for admission and outcome. Test Copy, expand tool and ephemeral-ui cards, open actions and approvals, scroll to old messages and back, open a second synthetic chat and return. Inspect empty, error and completed states with actual screenshots.

At 390px in the Tern web client open a synthetic chat, submit /hosts, tap every card tab and expand a host and agent, then /portfolio and /factory. Scroll through all transcript cards and tap actions. Open and close navigation, settings and overlays, check composer and Stop geometry and touch reachability. Capture clipping and coverage gaps.

In the Tern web client use Tab and Enter to open navigation, settings, shortcuts and overlays, test Escape and overlay stacking. Submit /glide and navigate approval controls without a pointer, scroll every transcript section, resize between narrow and wide browser layouts and re-open menus. Browser Ctrl chords are not native Tern shortcut certification. Record unsupported resize controls as gaps.
